text:
Ana Patel: Quick sync — Northshore has greenlit a pilot in Nova Scotia (their edge colo). They want: reserved capacity (4x A100-equiv), KMS integration (customer-managed key), marketplace listing in partner catalog, and a short joint announcement. Target ship date: 2025-02-14. Who can own quotas / legal / marketplace / infra?

Mike Chen: I can own infra quotas + provisioning. Need exact SKU IDs and an expected RPS/throughput estimate from the partner by EOD Wed. Also confirm whether we should reserve as Dedicated or Dedicated-burst.

Carlos (Northshore): We can provide workload profile — baseline 15k requests/day, burst to 50k/day. For reserved capacity we expect ~120 vGPUs equivalent (4x A100-equivalent nodes). We prefer Dedicated with burst enabled for Black Friday-like spikes. We can share logos + short partner blurb for marketplace.

Sophia Lee: Marketplace lead here — I’ll draft the listing. Can someone drop the logo files (SVG + PNG) and a 1-paragraph blurb. Also need the official partner name for legal.

Raj Malhotra: Security/KMS note — we require a customer-managed key flow and audit logs to meet our SOC requirements. If Northshore is providing the KMS, we need key rotation policy and proof of HSM-backed key storage. Also which cloud (AWS ca-central-1 or GCP ca-central)? Different flow for each.

Carlos (Northshore): Primary is AWS (ca-central-1) in the Nova Scotia colo; we can do AWS KMS customer keys tied to their account. Rotation policy monthly. We can provide SOC2 Type II attestation.

Ana Patel: OK — action items so far: 1) Mike to file quota request with cloud partner and share ticket # 2) Raj to list KMS requirements and acceptance checklist 3) Sophia to draft marketplace copy 4) Legal to prepare joint announcement blurb + PR guardrails. Deadline to hit internal reviews: 2025-01-30.

Mike Chen: Filing quota request now. Patch notes: opening ticket with cloud: `CREQ-NS-1778` — requesting 4 reserved nodes (a100-eq) + burst pool of 2x for 6 months. ETA for approval: 7-10 business days. Link to request: https://cloud-partner.example.com/CREQ-NS-1778

deploy-bot: Reserved capacity draft created in staging: `dedicated-ns-pilot-v1` — status: pending quotas.

Raj Malhotra: For acceptance tests we need: 
- KMS: key ARN + rotation policy doc
- Network: Private peering + VPC flow logs enabled
- Audit: access logs for inference runtime (last 90 days)
Please add these to the partner onboarding checklist.

Sophia Lee: Draft marketplace copy (first pass): 
"Northshore + Redwood: Low-latency Nova Scotia edge for latency-sensitive LLMs. Dedicated GPUs, customer-managed keys, and SLA-backed throughput."
Carlos (Northshore): Copy looks good, please add: "Supports private VPC peering and enterprise SLAs."

legal-ops: Heads up — need a short DPA addendum for the joint listing and a PR approval flow. We’ll need marketing assets and security claims vetted. ETA for legal review: 4 business days once draft is submitted.

Ana Patel: Risk callouts: if cloud quotas are delayed past 2025-01-30 we miss announcement target. Backup plan: soft-launch on Hosted with smaller nodes and no marketplace listing. Confirm who owns the backup plan.

Mike Chen: I’ll own backup plan (provision smaller instances, reconfigure routing). If quotas delayed, I’ll open emergency ticket and ping infra on-call.

Sophia Lee: Marketing: we’ll prepare a tepid "pilot availability" landing page if needed. Need hero image + 2 bullet points from engineering.

Carlos (Northshore): We’ll aim to upload assets by 2024-12-20. Can someone share the asset spec?

Sophia Lee: Spec: logo SVG (512px), PNG (1200x628) for socials, 1x 600-word partner blog draft. Drop assets to the shared path: https://go/redwood/partners/northshore/assets

Ana Patel: Closing ask: please update this thread with ticket links and approvals as they come in. Next sync Friday 14:00 UTC. :calendar:

Mike Chen: Added cloud ticket: https://cloud-partner.example.com/CREQ-NS-1778 (CREQ-NS-1778).

Raj Malhotra: KMS checklist posted to onboarding doc: https://go/redwood/security/kms-checklists#northshore 

Carlos (Northshore): Assets upload scheduled for 2024-12-18. We'll also email legal a contact for DPA.

Ana Patel: Great. Thanks all.
